extracted.name: Cilantro, Avocado, Tomato, and Feta Salad
extracted.description: This fresh tomato, avocado, feta salad uses bunches of cilantro, plus tomatoes, green onions, jalapeño peppers, ripe avocado, and tangy cheese.
ingredient_lines: 4 ounces crumbled garlic and herb feta cheese
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Combine tomatoes, jalapeño peppers, green onion, and feta cheese in a large bowl; toss together. Add diced avocado; drizzle lemon juice over avocado to keep it from turning brown. Stir in cilantro. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well and serve.
